identity.title: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer
identity.summary: Systems Engineer with over 4 years of hands-on experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting. Responsible for maintaining infrastructure stability and supporting daily operations across virtualization and cloud environments. Recognized for a practical approach in resolving issues and effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.
